summary.description: Executive summary of the document content. 3-5 sentences. Descriptive, not theoretical. Max ~300 words.

document_type.description: Type of document: interview, focus_group, field_note, written_document, transcript, other.

main_topics.description: Main topics discussed, ordered by prominence. 3-6 descriptive labels.

topic.description: Descriptive topic label (e.g., 'experiences with AI tools at work'). NOT a CGT code.

coverage.description: How much of the document discusses this topic.

participants.description: Key participants identified in the document.

role.description: Role or position relative to the population.

profile_notes.description: Relevant demographic or contextual details mentioned.

is_primary_speaker.description: true if this is the main participant.

emotional_tone.description: Dominant emotional tone of the document.

contradictions.description: Contradictions or ambivalence in the participant's account.

rich_passages.description: Notably rich descriptions, vivid examples, stories, or metaphors. Potential in-vivo code sources.

properline_indicators.description: Moments where the participant seems to say what they should say rather than what they actually experience.

richness.description: Estimated richness for CGT analysis. rich = dense behavioral descriptions. moderate = useful but some thin sections. thin = brief, abstract, or mostly properline.

richness_rationale.description: Why this richness level was assigned.
